title: Pomegranate Peel Extract Mitigates Diarrhea-Predominant Irritable Bowel Syndromes via MAPK and NF-kappaB Pathway Modulation in Rats.
authors: Zhang, Yannan; Huang, Sijuan; Zhang, Shuai; Hao, Zhihui; Shen, Jianzhong
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨石榴皮提取物通过MAPK和NF-kappaB通路缓解腹泻型肠易激综合征，核心为疾病治疗机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome (IBS-D) is a common chronic functional gastrointestinal disorder that causes diarrheal and intestinal barrier disruptions. Although pomegranate peel extract (PPE) has been reported for the treatment of diarrheal and intestinal inflammation, its effectiveness and mechanisms specifically for the treatment of IBS-D remain unknown. OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to explore the therapeutic effect of PPE on IBS-D and elucidate its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: A high-fat diet, restraint stress, and senna gavage were combined to establish a rat model mimicking IBS-D, to evaluate the therapeutic effects of PPE. Network pharmacology analysis, serum medicinal chemistry, and transcriptomics were employed to investigate potential downstream signaling pathways. Findings were further validated through molecular docking and Western blot analysis. RESULTS: The findings revealed that PPE significantly improved the symptoms of IBS-D, ameliorated intestinal inflammation, and promoted intestinal barrier function. The target genes in the MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways were significantly enriched and down-regulated. Molecular docking and Western blot assays were performed to verify that PPE had a high affinity for the protein candidates in these pathways, and significantly down-regulated the expression of p-IkappaB, p-p65, p-JNK, p-p38, and p-ERK1/2. CONCLUSIONS: The present study is the first to demonstrate that PPE alleviates diarrheal and intestinal damage in IBS-D, potentially by inhibiting MAPK and NF-kappaB signaling pathways. These findings suggest that PPE may provide a novel therapeutic option for IBS-D.
abstract_zh: 背景：腹泻型肠易激综合征（IBS-D）是一种常见的慢性功能性胃肠疾病，导致腹泻和肠道屏障破坏。尽管石榴皮提取物（PPE）已被报道用于治疗腹泻和肠道炎症，但其在IBS-D治疗中的有效性和具体机制仍不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨PPE对IBS-D的治疗效果，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：采用高脂饮食、束缚应激和番泻叶灌胃相结合的方法建立模拟IBS-D的大鼠模型，以评估PPE的治疗效果。通过网络药理学分析、血清药物化学和转录组学研究潜在的下游信号通路。通过分子对接和Western blot分析进一步验证研究结果。结果：研究发现，PPE显著改善了IBS-D的症状，减轻了肠道炎症，并促进了肠道屏障功能。MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路中的靶基因显著富集并下调。通过分子对接和Western blot实验验证，PPE对这些通路中的候选蛋白具有高亲和力，并显著下调p-IkappaB、p-p65、p-JNK、p-p38和p-ERK1/2的表达。结论：本研究首次证明PPE通过可能抑制MAPK和NF-kappaB信号通路，缓解IBS-D中的腹泻和肠道损伤。这些发现表明，PPE可能为IBS-D提供一种新的治疗选择。
